first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, while prior evidence suggests that reducing signup friction and shortening onboarding improve early activation and time-to-value. I would verify both closely related records before committing. A small guarded test can address the funnel deterioration without sacrificing qualified-revenue quality or relying on broad discounting that may attract lower-value accounts.

final.rationale: Run a small guarded SMB-focused onboarding simplification test, prioritizing fewer signup fields and a shorter path to first value. The verified records directly address both current problems: signup simplification increased activation 9% and qualified revenue 4%, while shortened onboarding improved completion 13%, time-to-value by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention 3%. Guard the rollout because signup simplification showed a 1% retention decline and has not been validated beyond SMB. Evaluate activation, completion, qualified revenue, and retention before expansion.
